articles.summary: The Behind Every Carton Tour will bring real family farmers to more than 20 Sprouts Farmers Market stores across Colorado, Arizona and California starting October 13; Vital Farms will also launch new nationwide out-of-home and digital creative in partnership with GUT Miami and Dentsu X highlighting the brand’s “See The Farm” initiative. Vital Farms (Nasdaq: VITL) announced today the launch of the “Behind Every Carton” campaign, which celebrates the more than 600 real family farms that help bring ethical food to the table every day. Behind Every Carton celebrates Vital Farms’ direct relationships with the farmers who produce eggs for consumers every day. At a time when much of the egg aisle feels far removed from the farm, Vital Farms takes a different approach, building real connections with the real people who care for the hens and do the work. Through in-person events and national out-of-home and digital creative, the campaign brings the farmers, their farms and their stories closer
articles.title: Vital Farms Launches the “Behind Every Carton” Campaign to Show Consumers the Real Farms and Farmers Who Produce the Good Eggs Every Day
